POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}, {"type": "dns", "value": "www.example.org"}]}
$code == 201
capture order = $header.Location
capture finalize = $body.finalize
capture authz0 = $body.authorizations[0]
capture authz1 = $body.authorizations[1]

# The CSR can list the names in a different sequence than the order.
csr goodCSR certKey www.example.org example.org

# A pending order can't be finalized.
POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$goodCSR"}
$code == 403
error == orderNotReady

POST-as-GET $authz0
capture chall0 = $body.challenges[0].url

POST-as-GET $authz1
capture chall1 = $body.challenges[0].url

POST $chall0
payload {}
$body.status == valid

POST $chall1
payload {}
$body.status == valid

POST-as-GET $order
$body.status == ready
$body.certificate !exists

# The CSR must be valid, and request exactly the order's identifiers.
POST $finalize
payload {}
error == badCSR

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "not base64url!"}
error == badCSR

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "AAAA"}
error == badCSR

csr subsetCSR certKey example.org

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$subsetCSR"}
error == badCSR

csr supersetCSR certKey example.org www.example.org other.example.org

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$supersetCSR"}
error == badCSR

csr accountKeyCSR account example.org www.example.org

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$accountKeyCSR"}
error == badCSR

# Failed finalizations leave the order ready.
POST-as-GET $order
$body.status == ready

# Orders can only be finalized by their account.
POST $dir.newAccount as account2
payload {}
$code == 201

POST $finalize as account2
payload {"csr": "$goodCSR"}
error == unauthorized

# Finalization waits for the certificate to be issued.
POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$goodCSR"}
$body.status == valid
$body.certificate ~ ^https://read.magnolia.test/66252[.]99999[.]1/certificate/1/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}/1-[A-Z2-7]{8}$$
$body.error !exists
$header.Location == $order
capture certificate = $body.certificate

POST-as-GET $order
$body.status == valid
$body.certificate == $certificate

# A valid order can't be finalized again.
POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$goodCSR"}
$code == 403
error == orderNotReady

# Index 0 is the null entry, so certificates start at 1 and get consecutive
# indexes. Keys can be reused across orders.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.com"}]}
$code == 201
capture order2 = $header.Location
capture finalize2 = $body.finalize
capture order2Authz = $body.authorizations[0]

POST-as-GET $order2Authz
capture order2Chall = $body.challenges[0].url

POST $order2Chall
payload {}
$body.status == valid

csr csr2 certKey example.com

POST $finalize2
payload {"csr": "$csr2"}
$body.status == valid
$body.certificate ~ /2-[A-Z2-7]{8}$$

# ML-DSA-87 keys are supported.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.net"}]}
$code == 201
capture finalize3 = $body.finalize
capture order3Authz = $body.authorizations[0]

POST-as-GET $order3Authz
capture order3Chall = $body.challenges[0].url

POST $order3Chall
payload {}
$body.status == valid

key bigKey ML-DSA-87

csr csr3 bigKey example.net

POST $finalize3
payload {"csr": "$csr3"}
$body.status == valid
$body.certificate ~ /3-[A-Z2-7]{8}$$
